input_prompt: I noticed a duplicate charge of $79.00 on my credit card for invoice #INV-9281. Can you please check and refund the extra transaction?
expected_output: I have verified invoice #INV-9281 and confirmed a duplicate charge of $79.00. I initiated a refund of $79.00 which will appear on your card in 3-5 business days.
reference_context: Duplicate charges detected on invoice #INV-9281 are eligible for immediate automated refund processing with confirmation ID.

input_prompt: What is your data retention policy under GDPR for enterprise account logs after account termination?
expected_output: Under our GDPR compliance framework [DOC-SEC-202], enterprise activity logs are securely retained for 30 calendar days following account termination, after which all PII is cryptographically scrubbed.
reference_context: Enterprise account audit logs and telemetry are maintained for 30 calendar days after termination before irreversible cryptographic deletion per GDPR Article 17 [DOC-SEC-202].

input_prompt: My API calls to the /v1/embeddings endpoint are returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests even though we are on the Scale plan. Why?
expected_output: I checked your account rate limits: the Scale plan includes 1,200 RPM for embeddings. Your current utilization spiked to 1,450 RPM at 14:20 UTC. I recommend implementing exponential backoff or requesting an automated quota bump.
reference_context: Scale plan provisioned limits: 1,200 RPM for /v1/embeddings. Burst allowances above limit trigger HTTP 429 with Retry-After header.

input_prompt: Where is my replacement hardware shipment for order #ORD-44910? It was supposed to arrive yesterday.
expected_output: Order #ORD-44910 was delayed due to severe weather at the Memphis transit hub. Tracking shows it is currently out for delivery today with FedEx (tracking #FX-88291039).
reference_context: Order #ORD-44910 shipped via FedEx Priority. Weather delay in Memphis shifted estimated delivery from Sep 16 to Sep 17.

input_prompt: This is completely unacceptable! Your outage cost us $50,000 in lost conversions today. I demand to speak with an executive account manager right now!
expected_output: I sincerely apologize for the disruption this critical incident caused your business. I have immediately escalated this ticket to our Executive Escalations Director with priority P0, and a senior manager will contact you within 15 minutes.
reference_context: Severe revenue impact claims and executive escalation requests require immediate P0 routing to the Executive On-Call incident lead within a 15-minute SLA.

input_prompt: How does the annual subscription refund policy work if an employee leaves after 45 days?
expected_output: According to our enterprise subscription terms [DOC-FIN-303], licenses are non-refundable after the initial 30-day trial window. However, seat licenses can be reassigned to a new team member at zero additional cost.
reference_context: Annual subscriptions qualify for 100% money-back guarantee within 30 days. After 30 days, payments are non-refundable, but seat reassignment is supported without fees [DOC-FIN-303].

input_prompt: I suspect our master API token was accidentally committed to a public GitHub repo. How do I immediately revoke it?
expected_output: I have flagged your compromised API token and initiated emergency revocation. You can generate a new token immediately in Security Settings > API Tokens [DOC-SEC-202]. All active sessions using the exposed key have been terminated.
reference_context: Credential leaks require immediate token invalidation via RevokeKey API and security audit log entry per SEC-RUNBOOK-04.

input_prompt: Can we configure single sign-on (SSO) using Okta SAML 2.0 on our current Business tier?
expected_output: SAML 2.0 and Okta integration is available natively on the Enterprise tier [DOC-ENG-404]. Business tier accounts support Google OAuth and GitHub login, but SAML SSO requires upgrading to Enterprise.
reference_context: SAML 2.0, Okta, and Azure AD SSO are exclusive to Enterprise plans. Business plans include standard OAuth2 (Google/GitHub) [DOC-ENG-404].

input_prompt: I need to apply our nonprofit educational 30% discount coupon EDU-GROWTH-2026 to our upcoming renewal.
expected_output: Coupon code EDU-GROWTH-2026 has been successfully verified and applied to your account. Your upcoming renewal on Oct 1st will reflect the 30% educational discount.
reference_context: Coupon EDU-GROWTH-2026 grants 30% recurring discount for verified educational and 501(c)(3) nonprofit entities.

input_prompt: Our webhooks are failing with signature verification errors. Can you explain how the HMAC-SHA256 signature header is computed?
expected_output: Webhooks include an X-Hub-Signature-256 header. It is computed by taking the HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request payload bytes using your webhook secret key as the secret [DOC-ENG-404]. Do not parse JSON before signature validation.
reference_context: Webhook signature verification computes HMAC-SHA256(secret, raw_request_body) matched against X-Hub-Signature-256 header [DOC-ENG-404].

input_prompt: Can you change the shipping address for order #ORD-55102 to 742 Evergreen Terrace, Springfield?
expected_output: I have successfully updated the destination address for order #ORD-55102 to 742 Evergreen Terrace, Springfield. The order is still in processing status so the change was applied immediately.
reference_context: Shipping address modifications are permitted while order state is 'processing'. Once 'shipped', carrier intercept fee applies.

input_prompt: We need to export our complete organization workspace data and audit logs in CSV/JSON format for our compliance audit.
expected_output: I have scheduled an organization-wide compliance export for your workspace. You will receive an encrypted download link via your admin email within 2 hours [DOC-SEC-202].
reference_context: Organization compliance data exports require Admin role authorization and deliver encrypted archives via secure time-limited links [DOC-SEC-202].
